feedback.end: Camels store fat in their humps and can last a long time without food or water. This Arabic camel has one hump, but some camels have two.
Lizards are cold-blooded animals, which means they have to control their own body temperature. They sit in the sun to warm up and hide in burrows in the sand to cool down.
Fennec foxes have large ears, which help them lose heat quickly. They also have hairy feet to protect them from the hot sand.

atoms.a: Deserts get a lot of rain.
Deserts are too dry, so no animals live there.
Deserts are a natural habitat for many plants and animals.
